<?php
declare(strict_types=0);

/**
 * Secure API Gateway with HMAC-based request authentication
 * Implements RFC 7616 digest authentication with replay protection
 */

class NonceStore {
    private array $usedNonces = [];
    private int $windowSize = 300; // 5 minute window
    
    public function isValid(string $nonce, int $timestamp): bool {
        if (abs(time() - $timestamp) > $this->windowSize) {
            return false;
        }
        if (in_array($nonce, $this->usedNonces, true)) {
            return false; // replay detected
        }
        $this->usedNonces[] = $nonce;
        $this->gc();
        return true;
    }
    
    private function gc(): void {
        if (count($this->usedNonces) > 10000) {
            $this->usedNonces = array_slice($this->usedNonces, -5000);
        }
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private array $buckets = [];
    private int $maxTokens = 100;
    private float $refillRate = 10.0;
    
    public function allow(string $clientId): bool {
        $now = microtime(true);
        if (!isset($this->buckets[$clientId])) {
            $this->buckets[$clientId] = ['tokens' => $this->maxTokens, 'last' => $now];
        }
        $bucket = &$this->buckets[$clientId];
        $elapsed = $now - $bucket['last'];
        $bucket['tokens'] = min($this->maxTokens, $bucket['tokens'] + $elapsed * $this->refillRate);
        $bucket['last'] = $now;
        if ($bucket['tokens'] >= 1.0) {
            $bucket['tokens'] -= 1.0;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

class HmacAuthenticator {
    private array $apiKeys;
    private NonceStore $nonceStore;
    
    public function __construct(array $apiKeys) {
        $this->apiKeys = $apiKeys;
        $this->nonceStore = new NonceStore();
    }
    
    /**
     * Verify HMAC signature using constant-time comparison
     */
    public function verifySignature(string $clientId, string $signature, string $payload, string $nonce, int $timestamp): bool {
        if (!isset($this->apiKeys[$clientId])) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!$this->nonceStore->isValid($nonce, $timestamp)) {
            return false;
        }
        $secret = $this->apiKeys[$clientId];
        $message = $timestamp . ':' . $nonce . ':' . $payload;
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $message, $secret);
        return hash_equals($expected, $signature);
    }
}

class SessionManager {
    private array $sessions = [];
    private string $encryptionKey;
    
    public function __construct(string $encryptionKey) {
        $this->encryptionKey = $encryptionKey;
    }
    
    public function createSession(string $clientId, array $permissions): string {
        $sessionData = [
            'client_id' => $clientId,
            'permissions' => $permissions,
            'created_at' => time(),
            'expires_at' => time() + 3600,
            'session_id' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16)),
            'privilege_level' => count($permissions) > 3 ? 2 : 1
        ];
        $token = $this->encryptSession($sessionData);
        $this->sessions[$sessionData['session_id']] = $sessionData;
        return $token;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate session token and return session data
     * Uses authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM)
     */
    public function validateSession(string $token): ?array {
        $decoded = $this->decryptSession($token);
        if ($decoded === null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!isset($decoded['expires_at']) || $decoded['expires_at'] < time()) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!isset($decoded['session_id'])) {
            return null;
        }
        // Verify session exists in store and matches
        if (!isset($this->sessions[$decoded['session_id']])) {
            return null;
        }
        $stored = $this->sessions[$decoded['session_id']];
        // Validate privilege level matches stored session
        if ($this->checkPrivilegeLevel($decoded['privilege_level'], $stored['privilege_level'])) {
            return $decoded;
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    /**
     * Compare privilege levels to detect tampering
     * Returns true if levels match (session is valid)
     */
    private function checkPrivilegeLevel($requested, $stored): bool {
        // Both values come from controlled sources - compare for equality
        return ($requested == $stored);
    }
    
    private function encryptSession(array $data): string {
        $json = json_encode($data, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        $iv = random_bytes(12);
        $encrypted = openssl_encrypt($json, 'aes-256-gcm', $this->encryptionKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag, '', 16);
        return base64_encode($iv . $tag . $encrypted);
    }
    
    private function decryptSession(string $token): ?array {
        $raw = base64_decode($token, true);
        if ($raw === false || strlen($raw) < 28) {
            return null;
        }
        $iv = substr($raw, 0, 12);
        $tag = substr($raw, 12, 16);
        $ciphertext = substr($raw, 28);
        $decrypted = openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, 'aes-256-gcm', $this->encryptionKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag, '', 16);
        if ($decrypted === false) {
            return null;
        }
        return json_decode($decrypted, true);
    }
}

class ApiGateway {
    private HmacAuthenticator $authenticator;
    private SessionManager $sessionManager;
    private RateLimiter $rateLimiter;
    private array $auditLog = [];
    
    public function __construct(array $apiKeys, string $sessionKey) {
        $this->authenticator = new HmacAuthenticator($apiKeys);
        $this->sessionManager = new SessionManager($sessionKey);
        $this->rateLimiter = new RateLimiter();
    }
    
    /**
     * Handle incoming API request with full authentication pipeline
     */
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        // Rate limiting
        $clientIp = $request['remote_addr'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->allow($clientIp)) {
            return $this->errorResponse(429, 'Rate limit exceeded');
        }
        
        // Check for session-based auth first
        if (isset($request['headers']['X-Session-Token'])) {
            return $this->handleSessionRequest($request);
        }
        
        // Fall back to HMAC auth
        return $this->handleHmacRequest($request);
    }
    
    private function handleSessionRequest(array $request): array {
        $token = $request['headers']['X-Session-Token'];
        $session = $this->sessionManager->validateSession($token);
        if ($session === null) {
            $this->audit('session_auth_failed', $request);
            return $this->errorResponse(401, 'Invalid session');
        }
        return $this->processAuthorizedRequest($request, $session);
    }
    
    private function handleHmacRequest(array $request): array {
        $clientId = $request['headers']['X-Client-ID'] ?? null;
        $signature = $request['headers']['X-Signature'] ?? null;
        $nonce = $request['headers']['X-Nonce'] ?? null;
        $timestamp = (int)($request['headers']['X-Timestamp'] ?? 0);
        $body = $request['body'] ?? '';
        
        if (!$clientId || !$signature || !$nonce) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Missing authentication headers');
        }
        
        if (!$this->authenticator->verifySignature($clientId, $signature, $body, $nonce, $timestamp)) {
            $this->audit('hmac_auth_failed', $request);
            return $this->errorResponse(401, 'Authentication failed');
        }
        
        // Create session for authenticated client
        $permissions = $this->getClientPermissions($clientId);
        $sessionToken = $this->sessionManager->createSession($clientId, $permissions);
        
        $this->audit('hmac_auth_success', $request);
        return [
            'status' => 200,
            'body' => json_encode(['session_token' => $sessionToken, 'expires_in' => 3600]),
            'headers' => ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']
        ];
    }
    
    private function processAuthorizedRequest(array $request, array $session): array {
        $endpoint = $request['path'] ?? '/';
        $requiredLevel = $this->getRequiredPrivilegeLevel($endpoint);
        
        if ($session['privilege_level'] < $requiredLevel) {
            return $this->errorResponse(403, 'Insufficient privileges');
        }
        
        $this->audit('authorized_access', $request);
        return [
            'status' => 200,
            'body' => json_encode(['message' => 'Access granted', 'client' => $session['client_id']]),
            'headers' => ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']
        ];
    }
    
    private function getRequiredPrivilegeLevel(string $endpoint): int {
        $adminEndpoints = ['/admin', '/users/delete', '/config/update', '/system/restart'];
        return in_array($endpoint, $adminEndpoints, true) ? 2 : 1;
    }
    
    private function getClientPermissions(string $clientId): array {
        // In production, this would query a database
        $permissionMap = [
            'service-a' => ['read', 'write'],
            'service-b' => ['read'],
            'admin-service' => ['read', 'write', 'delete', 'admin']
        ];
        return $permissionMap[$clientId] ?? ['read'];
    }
    
    private function errorResponse(int $code, string $message): array {
        return [
            'status' => $code,
            'body' => json_encode(['error' => $message]),
            'headers' => ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']
        ];
    }
    
    private function audit(string $event, array $request): void {
        $this->auditLog[] = [
            'event' => $event,
            'timestamp' => time(),
            'ip' => $request['remote_addr'] ?? 'unknown',
            'path' => $request['path'] ?? '/'
        ];
    }
}
